blocks.text: Pani zindagi ki bunyaad hai. Pani peene (hydration) aur safai (hygiene) se insan zinda aur sehatmand rehte hain, aur pani jism se toxic (zehreele) materials bahar nikalta hai. Paude pani ki madad se photosynthesis karte hain, aur pani se fasal (crop) ugti hai, is liye agriculture (kheti) pani par chalti hai. Janwar apne jism ke kaam theek rakhne ke liye pani par depend karte hain, aur be-shumar microorganisms (khurdbeeni jandaar) bhi pani ke baghair zinda nahi reh sakte. Human development (insani taraqqi), agriculture aur food security (sab ke liye kaafi khuraak) sab pani ki steady (lagataar) supply par tiki hain.

Nature (qudrat) mein pani zameen ki shakal banata hai, climate (mausam) ko balance mein rakhta hai aur underground reservoirs (zameen ke neeche pani ke zakhire) dobara bharta hai. Darya, jheelein, wetlands (daldali ilaqe) aur samandar jaise ecosystems paudon aur janwaron ki mukhtalif zindagi ke liye pani par depend karte hain. Energy production (bijli waghera banana), transport, urban development (shehron ki taraqqi) aur scientific research ke liye bhi pani zaroori hai. Water scarcity (pani ki kami) environment (mahol), communities (logon) aur economies (maeeshat) sab ke liye khatra hai.

blocks.prompt: Teen reasons (wajoohat) batayein ke pani zindagi ke liye kyun zaroori hai.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi teen: insan ko hydration aur safai ke liye pani chahiye aur pani toxic (zehreele) materials jism se nikalta hai; paude photosynthesis ke liye pani use karte hain; fasal aur food security pani par depend karti hai; janwar jism ke kaam theek rakhne ke liye pani par depend karte hain; ecosystems (darya, jheelein, samandar) pani par chalte hain.

items: Pani insan, paudon, janwaron aur microorganisms sab ke liye zaroori hai.
Pani mausam ko balance karta aur zameen ke neeche ka pani dobara bharta hai.
Water scarcity (pani ki kami) mahol, logon aur economy ke liye khatra hai.
